policy.measures: per_op_latency: percentiles of individually timed requests (client side, send to body read); values are the per-session percentiles, pooled is the same percentile over every kept request of the valid sessions. request_wall_time: per-session medians of paired per-round differences (variant - baseline_quality, in-process baseline vs current), and single-request times of the input-limits probe. heap_bytes: growth of the server process's peak resident memory over one request (PeakWorkingSetSize on Windows, VmHWM on Linux), not heap accounting
policy.outliers: no samples dropped; whole runs marked invalid on precondition failure
policy.values: run-level: one value per bench_quality.py session (http, pipeline) or per fresh-server probe run (limits), in run order
policy.warmup: bench_quality.py: 3 warm-up rounds per asset and session, not kept; every session starts fresh servers; pipeline A/B: one warm-up call per side and asset. limits_probe.py: one GET /health per fresh server before the request
